description:
🖼️A hidden pencil note. Four versions. One painting that turned fear into art 🎨 

📼 This retro-style motion piece uncovers the story behind The Scream. In 1892, Edvard Munch painted a haunting figure against a distorted landscape, then created four versions of it. One of them hides a strange inscription: “Could only have been painted by a madman!” 🔍

🎞️ Built with a vintage art-history look: textured backgrounds, dramatic typography, historical imagery, and atmospheric transitions that reveal how a simple image became a symbol of fear itself

⚡ Every distortion. Every color. Every detail, fully edit-driven and ready for your timeline
